endorsements.quote: TRIPOD+AI aims to promote the complete, accurate, and transparent reporting of studies that develop a prediction model or evaluate its performance.
Report model performance estimates with confidence intervals, including for any key subgroups (eg, sociodemographic).
Identify any differences between the development and evaluation data in healthcare setting, eligibility criteria, outcome, and predictors

Data should ideally include information from individuals of different ages, sexes/genders, and races/ethnicities, with different health conditions or comorbidities and from different geographical locations.

unlisted_practices: Authors of prediction model studies should follow the TRIPOD+AI checklist and submit a completed checklist with their manuscript.
Journal editors and publishers should require and enforce adherence to TRIPOD+AI during submission and peer review.
Funders should require funding applications for prediction model studies to include a plan to report according to TRIPOD+AI.
Researchers should involve patients and the public in the design, conduct, reporting, and dissemination of prediction model studies and report that involvement.
Researchers should practice open science by registering studies and sharing protocols, data, code, and the prediction model.
Researchers should describe approaches used to address model fairness and the rationale for them.
Researchers should report how poor quality or unavailable input data should be handled when implementing a prediction model.

screen.reason: The paper presents the TRIPOD+AI reporting guideline and checklist for prediction models using machine learning/AI methods.
